prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: COc1cc2ncnc(Nc3ccc(F)c(Cl)c3)c2cc1OCCCN1CCOCC1
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL203

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of EGFR
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of wild type EGFR (unknown origin) incubated for 5 mins by HTRF assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.72, "error_class": "none", "reason": "Both assays measure IC50 inhibition of wild-type human EGFR with high confidence scores, and while Assay B specifies HTRF with a 5-min incubation, the compound (gefitinib) is a well-characterized EGFR inhibitor whose potency is generally consistent across standard biochemical assay formats."}

parsed.reason: Both assays measure IC50 inhibition of wild-type human EGFR with high confidence scores, and while Assay B specifies HTRF with a 5-min incubation, the compound (gefitinib) is a well-characterized EGFR inhibitor whose potency is generally consistent across standard biochemical assay formats.
